main_text.p: MALITIA damnatur, Rom.1.29. Ephes.4.31. Col.3,8. Iac.1.21.1.Petr.2.1.malitia hominis multa, Gen.6.5. malitia omnis auferenda, Ephes.4.31. Col.3.8. malitiae veteris fermentum,1. Corint.5.8. In malitia perseuerantes pereunt, 1 Sam.12.25.malitia vt pueri efficiamur,studere debemus, 1.Cor.14.20.

MALVM omne fugiendum, Psal.34.15.& 37.27. & 119,v.101. 128.Prouerb.3.29.Esa.1.16.Ezech.18.21.Amos.5.15.Rom.12.9.1.Ioan.3.v.4.3 Ioan.3.v.11.Malum dicens bonum punie tur. Esa.5.20. Malach.2.17. Prou.24.24. Malum pro malo non reddendum, Prouerb. 17.13. & 20.22. & 24.29. Rom.12.v.14.17.1.Corint.4.12.1.Thess.5.15.1.Petr.3.9 (Vide VINDICTA) Malum bono vincendum, Rom.12.21.A malo ita abstinendum, vt quod bonum est facias,Psal.34.15. & 37.27. Esa. I.v.16.17, & 55.7. Ephes.4.28.1.Petr.3.11.

Malum poenae a Deo est,Deut.32.23 1.Reg.9.6 & 21.29. Esa.45.7.Ier.11.11.& 32.42.Amos,3.6. Ionae.3.10,Mich,1.12 & 2.3. malum culpae summe auertsatur Deus, tantum abest, vt eum autorem habeat, Exod.23, 7.2. Paral. 19.7. Iob.34.10. Psalm.5.v.5.7, & 45.8, Prou.15. v.8.9, Osee. 13, 9: Roman. 9,14,2, Cor.6.15, Iac.1.13, Malos Rectores & Praepositos permittit Deus ob peccata populi.2. Reg,12, 20,Iob 34.30,Esa.29.10,Ezech,14.6,Osee 13.11,2,Thess.2. 11.(Vide MAGISTRATAS:malus) Iubetque obedientiam illis praestare,Matt,23,3, malorum etiam ministrorum opera vtitur Deus,Matt.7.22. Marc.9,9,38. Luc.49.[malorum confortiu vitandum, vide SOCIETAS mali species fugienda.1, Thess,5.22, malo consentire quam noxium,Rom.1.32, malorum inuentores miseri, Prou,11,27.
MAMBRE Locus, siue vrbs, quae etiam dicitur Hebron, Genef.13,18.& 23.19.

MAMMONA iniquo parandi amici, Luc.16.9. estque vox Syra,idem significans quod Graecis μαμωνᾶς, diuitiae,& quaecunque ad rem pecuniariam pertinent, Matth,6,24,dicitur autē sic,quasi dicat,diuitiae fraudulentę,fallaces, fraudatrices,quòd (experientia teste) nihil iis incertius.

MANNAE & aquae ex petra profluentis coena,fuit sacramentum V. T. quo Israelitae cibo coelitus demisso alebantur, ad significandam spiritualem alimoniam carnis Christi, & aquâ ex rupe profluente potabantur, ad significandum spiritualem potum sanguinis Christi:1 Cor.10.3.4.Exod. 16.14. 15.Ioh.7.37.c.

page.notes: Marginal notes at the outer edges are cropped and largely illegible; not transcribed. Several line-end words are uncertain (e.g. "Vide VINDICTA", "[malorum", "MAGISTRATAS") and bracketed readings may be imperfect. The final "M AN" is a catchword-like running mark at the foot right and is recorded in main text as printed.
